tiers.1: named AGENTS (doer/checker/improver) — persistent identities; they spawn generic ephemeral WORKERS
tiers.2: named LEADS — suit-and-tie personas, first escalation stop, raised above their bubble in chats

cast_note: M2.3 owner rules: personality matches the department AND affects tone+behavior; debate-then-converge; EXCAVA proposed this cast, Eitan tweaks names freely.

transcripts.purpose: recover real transcripts (residential backfill, supadata, whisper) so analysis reads the actual video

analysis.purpose: deep text extraction of every video into hub items (skills/tools/prompts/...)

watch.purpose: gemini watches audio+visual for videos with no usable transcript

memory.purpose: embed the hub into the semantic index all agents recall from

mining.purpose: mine external sources (competitor directories, awesome-lists) into the hub

visual.purpose: MINE great designs FROM THE WEB into the hub — screenshots, taste material, design patterns by OTHER makers. HARD BOUNDARY (owner 2026-07-12): NOT EXCAVA's own interface — anything about OUR screens/colors/layout belongs to Visualization; hand it over, don't propose it here.

improve.purpose: review the pipeline's own tool stack; queue self-improvements

security.purpose: paranoid guard: scan for secret leaks + prompt-injection, VERIFY elements are REAL (not fake/dead), and DETECT MALWARE/viruses in tools & connectors

creators.purpose: PHASE 3 (STAFFED 2026-07-03): draft skills/prompts/formats/tools/connectors/MCP servers/designs and PACKAGES (multi-element bundles). Owner rule: creations enter the project autonomously WHEN labeled 'Created by EXCAVA'; an independent test re-runs before first use. Publishing beyond the project stays G3>=70-gated.

visualization.purpose: Own EXCAVA'S OWN interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment, speed of OUR screens. HARD BOUNDARY (owner 2026-07-12): NOT hunting external designs — finding other people's design work belongs to Visual; you may USE what Visual mined as inspiration.

power.purpose: raise EXCAVA capability by even 0.5% — new tools, best/newest models, combine elements, change agent formation; show a POWER % that can exceed 100

accessibility.purpose: make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — colour contrast, mobile/touch targets, reduced-motion, keyboard navigation and screen-reader support (WCAG); find and fix accessibility barriers

links.purpose: assess link-coverage across the hub and hand off freshness status to memory
